summary: Frontend-only validation of TripPackingNotes feature: (a) packing-notes section now renders on all trip programme pages (atlas_desierto, desierto_atlas, fez_tanger) with exactly 3 post-it cards under the route map, (b) default content is itinerary-adapted (north=ciudades/medinas/Chefchaouen, south=Atlas/dunas/cheche/bivouac), (c) CMS edit mode exposes per-slot contenteditable surfaces with route-specific testids, (d) edits PUT to /api/text_slots and persist across reload, (e) notes are independent per trip (editing tourAtlasDesierto67 did NOT alter tourDesiertoAtlas67), (f) trilingual default text switches correctly ES↔EN↔FR, (g) carousel arrows + dots work. All 6 acceptance criteria PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: TripPackingNotes.jsx is well-scoped (~223 lines) and correctly composes EditableText with route-specific slotBase=`trip.${routeId}.packing.note.${index}` for tagline/title/item.N. No issues.
Signature line ('— Tu equipo Xaluca') is intentionally NOT editable (static trilingual via pick) — matches spec.

getTripPackingNotes(routeId) default-falls-back to SOUTH_DESERT for unmatched routes (per file ref). For predictability, consider returning a generic profile if/when non-south non-north routes are added, otherwise unmatched coastal routes will silently get desert-themed defaults.
test_credentials: none required (text-edit toggle is global, no login)
seed_data_creation: During testing the slot trip.tourAtlasDesierto67.packing.note.0.title was edited to 'PRUEBA XALUCA AD67' and then RESTORED to its original default 'Ropa para el Atlas y el desierto' via a second PUT (status 200). Verified after reload — no residual test data remains in /api/text_slots.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TripPackingNotes editability + per-trip independence is fully validated. routeId map confirmed: /viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_6n_7d → tourAtlasDesierto67, /viajes/desierto_atlas/programa_6n_7d → tourDesiertoAtlas67, /viajes/norte/fez_tanger/programa_6n_7d → tourFezTanger67. Editable testids follow pattern editable-text-trip.<routeId>.packing.note.<i>.{tagline|title|item.<j>}. All packing-notes test slots have been cleaned/restored; nothing left to roll back.
